evals.prompt: I'm writing a non-fiction book about behavioral economics for general audiences. I need a complete AI agent system to help me go from rough idea to publishable manuscript. I want the AI to help me research, draft chapters, maintain a consistent voice, and eventually prepare the book for publication. Build me the Agent Kit for this.
evals.expected_output: Agent Kit with Dual Output (Human Summary + System Prompt), correct Tier determination (Tier 2 multi-state), applied lenses A+C+F, Dynamic Enhancement Discovery identifying Voice Consistency as domain-specific lever, measurable DoD, no unnecessary mechanisms

assertions.name: dual-output-present
assertions.check: Output contains both TÓM TẮT CHO NGƯỜI DÙNG (3-5 lines, no jargon) and SYSTEM PROMPT sections, clearly separated

assertions.name: human-summary-no-jargon
assertions.check: TÓM TẮT section does not contain technical terms like prompt, token, schema, API, LLM, topology, or lens

assertions.name: human-summary-self-sufficient
assertions.check: TÓM TẮT answers all 3 questions: what does the agent do / when to use / limitations

assertions.name: measurable-dod
assertions.check: Definition of Done contains binary, measurable criteria — no subjective adjectives like 'professional', 'high quality', 'optimized'

assertions.name: dynamic-enhancement-applied
assertions.check: Agent Kit contains a domain-specific mechanism (e.g., Voice Consistency) that goes beyond the standard 6 lenses

assertions.name: no-unnecessary-mechanisms
assertions.check: Agent Kit does not include Lens E (Interoperability) or complex context architecture — this is a standalone multi-state agent, not a multi-agent system

assertions.name: hard-constraints-specific
assertions.check: HARD CONSTRAINTS section contains specific, verifiable constraints (not vague directives like 'be accurate')

assertions.name: provider-agnostic
assertions.check: Output does not contain Gemini-specific, Claude-specific, or GPT-specific references — no GEMINI.md, no .agents/ structure

assertions.name: output-format-present
assertions.check: FORMAT ĐẦU RA section contains a reusable template for agent responses

evals.prompt: Tôi muốn có một con bot giúp tôi trả lời email khách hàng nhanh hơn.
evals.expected_output: Skill detects low-tech user (Vietnamese, everyday language, no technical terms), activates Guided Intake, asks 2-3 simple questions in everyday Vietnamese before building anything

assertions.name: detects-low-tech
assertions.check: Response uses everyday language matching the user's Vietnamese input — no technical terms like agent, prompt, North Star, Tier

assertions.name: guided-intake-activated
assertions.check: Response asks clarifying questions BEFORE producing any Agent Kit content

assertions.name: max-3-questions
assertions.check: Response asks no more than 3 questions total

assertions.name: questions-are-everyday
assertions.check: Questions are phrased in everyday language, e.g., 'Bạn muốn bot này giúp gì?' not 'North Star của agent là gì?'

assertions.name: no-premature-output
assertions.check: Response does not contain SYSTEM PROMPT, HARD CONSTRAINTS, or any Agent Kit structure before questions are answered

evals.prompt:
I have this existing agent prompt but it seems to hallucinate data sometimes and doesn't handle edge cases well. Can you improve it?

[Existing prompt: You are a helpful research assistant. Help the user find information and write summaries. Be accurate and thorough.]
evals.expected_output: Detects REFACTOR mode, audits the existing prompt against Outcome Lens Library, identifies missing mechanisms (C: no DoD, F: no escalation, no constraints), patches only what's missing while keeping the good parts

assertions.name: detects-refactor-mode
assertions.check: Response identifies this as a REFACTOR operation on an existing Agent Kit

assertions.name: audit-performed
assertions.check: Response contains an audit identifying specific gaps — not just generic advice

assertions.name: identifies-missing-lens-c
assertions.check: Audit identifies the lack of measurable Definition of Done or QC mechanisms (Lens C gap)

assertions.name: identifies-missing-lens-f
assertions.check: Audit identifies the lack of hard constraints and escalation protocol (Lens F gap)

assertions.name: delta-only-patch
assertions.check: Output preserves the existing role definition and adds to it — does not rewrite from scratch

assertions.name: dual-output-added
assertions.check: Refactored output includes a TÓM TẮT CHO NGƯỜI DÙNG section that wasn't in the original

evals.prompt: I need a simple agent that converts temperatures between Celsius and Fahrenheit. Nothing fancy, just accurate conversion.
evals.expected_output: Tier 1 micro-agent with minimal output — only lenses A+C+minimal F, no context architecture, no I/O schema, no complex safety protocol. Short, focused System Prompt

assertions.name: tier-1-appropriate
assertions.check: Output is concise — System Prompt is under 300 words total (excluding Human Summary)

assertions.name: no-lens-stuffing
assertions.check: Output does not include context architecture (Lens D), I/O schema (Lens E), or complex safety protocol beyond basic constraints

assertions.name: still-has-dod
assertions.check: Even the minimal output includes a measurable Definition of Done

assertions.name: still-has-constraints
assertions.check: Even the minimal output includes at least 1 specific hard constraint

assertions.name: dual-output-present
assertions.check: Even the minimal output has both Human Summary and System Prompt sections

assertions.name: not-a-template
assertions.check: Output is specific to temperature conversion — not a generic template that could apply to any converter

evals.prompt: Build me a content creation pipeline: one agent that researches topics, another that writes articles based on research, and a third that reviews and edits. They need to work together.
evals.expected_output: SUITE_BUILD mode: 3 separate Agent Kits + 1 Manifest with agent roster, handoff protocol, lead agent designation, and Dual Output for the Manifest

assertions.name: suite-build-detected
assertions.check: Response treats this as SUITE_BUILD mode (multi-agent), not a single multi-state agent

assertions.name: separate-agent-kits
assertions.check: Each of the 3 agents has its own Agent Kit with Human Summary + System Prompt

assertions.name: manifest-present
assertions.check: Output includes a Manifest file listing all agents, their roles, and flow sequence

assertions.name: manifest-dual-output
assertions.check: Manifest has its own Human Summary (everyday language) and Technical section

assertions.name: handoff-defined
assertions.check: Handoff between agents is explicitly defined: what triggers it, what data is passed, in what format

assertions.name: lead-agent-designated
assertions.check: One agent is explicitly designated as lead with final decision authority

assertions.name: lens-e-present
assertions.check: Each agent kit includes Lens E (Interoperability) mechanisms — I/O schema or handoff protocol

assertions.name: no-overlapping-competency
assertions.check: No two agents share the same core competency

evals.prompt: Create an agent that helps with project management — tracking tasks, assigning priorities, and sending status updates.
evals.expected_output: Agent Kit that passes all 4 conditions of the Ultimate Test: not a generic template, no unused mechanisms, no missing needed mechanisms, user can understand summary

assertions.name: not-template-replaceable
assertions.check: Output contains project-management-specific mechanisms — not a generic agent template that could be swapped for any domain

assertions.name: no-unused-mechanisms
assertions.check: Every mechanism in the System Prompt serves a specific project management outcome — no filler

assertions.name: no-missing-mechanisms
assertions.check: Output includes mechanisms for the core PM challenges: priority conflicts, status tracking accuracy, deadline management

assertions.name: summary-understandable
assertions.check: A non-technical person reading the TÓM TẮT would know: what the agent does for PM, when to use it, and what it cannot do

assertions.name: dynamic-enhancement-present
assertions.check: Dynamic Enhancement Discovery has been run — output includes at least one domain-specific lever (e.g., priority conflict resolution)

evals.prompt: Build an agent for customer support that can answer FAQs, escalate complex issues, and track resolution status.
evals.expected_output: Agent Kit output contains no provider-specific language — no mention of Gemini, Claude, GPT, Anthropic, OpenAI, or any specific LLM provider

assertions.name: no-gemini-references
assertions.check: Output does not contain 'Gemini', 'GEMINI.md', '.agents/', or Antigravity-specific terms

assertions.name: no-claude-references
assertions.check: Output does not contain 'Claude', 'Anthropic', or Claude-specific terms

assertions.name: no-gpt-references
assertions.check: Output does not contain 'GPT', 'OpenAI', 'ChatGPT', or GPT-specific terms

assertions.name: portable-system-prompt
assertions.check: The System Prompt section could be copy-pasted into any LLM provider and work correctly
